### 索引 1
- **问题:** Among the "Mountain-500 Black" product types, which type was purchased the most?
- **数据库:** sales
- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT P.Name, SUM(S.Quantity) AS TotalQuantity FROM Products P JOIN Sales S ON P.ProductID = S.ProductID WHERE P.Name LIKE 'Mountain-500 Black%' GROUP BY P.ProductID ORDER BY TotalQuantity DESC LIMIT 1;
- **标准SQL:** SELECT T1.Name FROM Products AS T1 INNER JOIN Sales AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID WHERE T1.Name LIKE 'Mountain-500 Black%' GROUP BY T2.Quantity, T1.Name ORDER BY SUM(T2.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

### 索引 2
- **问题:** How many games did Per Mars play in the 1997-1998 season?
- **数据库:** ice_hockey_draft
- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT SUM(GP) AS TotalGames FROM SeasonStatus WHERE ELITEID = (SELECT ELITEID FROM PlayerInfo WHERE PlayerName = 'Per Mars') AND SEASON = '1997-1998';
- **标准SQL:** SELECT T2.GP FROM PlayerInfo AS T1 INNER JOIN SeasonStatus AS T2 ON T1.ELITEID = T2.ELITEID WHERE T2.SEASON = '1997-1998' AND T1.PlayerName = 'Pavel Patera'

### 索引 3
- **问题:** Name the title and publisher for title ID BU 2075. Provide all the royalty percentage for all ranges.
- **数据库:** book_publishing_company
- **失败原因:** sql_execution_failed
- **模型SQL:** SELECT t.title AS title_name, p.pub_name AS publisher_name, r.lorange, r.hirange, r.royalty FROM titles t JOIN publishers p ON t.pub_id = p.pub_id LEFT JOIN roysched r ON t.title_id = r.title_id WHERE t.title_id = 'BU 2075';
- **标准SQL:** SELECT T1.title, T3.pub_name, T2.lorange, T2.hirange, T2.royalty FROM titles AS T1 INNER JOIN roysched AS T2 ON T1.title_id = T2.title_id INNER JOIN publishers AS T3 ON T1.pub_id = T3.pub_id WHERE T1.title_id = 'BU2075'

### 索引 19
- **问题:** Calculate the monthly average salary of the employee with highest salary. Mention his name, position title and location city.
- **数据库:** human_resources
- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT e.firstname || ' ' || e.lastname AS name, p.positiontitle, l.locationcity, CAST(MAX(e.salary) AS FLOAT) / 12 AS monthly_average_salary FROM employee e JOIN position p ON e.positionID = p.positionID JOIN location l ON e.locationID = l.locationID WHERE e.salary = (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM employee);
- **标准SQL:** SELECT SUM(CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(T1.salary, 4), ',', '') AS REAL)) / 12 AS avg, T1.firstname, T1.lastname , T2.positiontitle, T3.locationcity FROM employee AS T1  INNER JOIN position AS T2  ON T1.positionID = T2.positionID INNER JOIN location AS T3  ON T1.locationID = T3.locationID WHERE CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(T1.salary, 4), ',', '') AS REAL) = ( SELECT MAX(CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(T1.salary, 4), ',', '') AS REAL)) FROM employee AS T1  INNER JOIN position AS T2  ON T1.positionID = T2.positionID INNER JOIN location AS T3  ON T1.locationID = T3.locationID )

### 索引 30
- **问题:** How many times more for the papers that were presented at the "International Conference on Thermoelectrics" conference than "International Conference on Wireless Networks, Communications and Mobile Computing“ conference?
- **数据库:** authors
- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN Conference.FullName = 'International Conference on Thermoelectrics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Conference.FullName = 'International Conference on Wireless Networks, Communications and Mobile Computing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS PaperDifference FROM Paper INNER JOIN Conference ON Paper.ConferenceId = Conference.Id;
- **标准SQL:** SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.FullName = 'International Conference on Thermoelectrics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.FullName = 'International Conference on Wireless Networks, Communications and Mobile Computing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Paper AS T1 INNER JOIN Conference AS T2 ON T1.ConferenceId = T2.Id

### 索引 73
- **问题:** Among the movies with drama genre, what is the percentage of the actors with net worth greater than $400,000,000.00?
- **数据库:** movie
- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT (CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.NetWorth > '$400,000,000.00' THEN a.ActorID END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.ActorID)) * 100 AS Percentage FROM movie m INNER JOIN characters c ON m.MovieID = c.MovieID INNER JOIN actor a ON c.ActorID = a.ActorID WHERE m.Genre = 'Drama';

### 索引 74
- **问题:** What is the number of installments of the app with the highest total Sentiment polarity score?
- **数据库:** app_store
- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT p.Installs FROM playstore p JOIN (SELECT App, SUM(Sentiment_Polarity) AS Total_Sentiment FROM user_reviews GROUP BY App HAVING SUM(Sentiment_Polarity) = (SELECT MAX(Total_Sentiment) FROM (SELECT App, SUM(Sentiment_Polarity) AS Total_Sentiment FROM user_reviews GROUP BY App))) AS max_sentiment_apps ON p.App = max_sentiment_apps.App;
- **标准SQL:** SELECT T1.Installs FROM playstore AS T1 INNER JOIN user_reviews AS T2 ON T1.App = T2.App GROUP BY T1.App ORDER BY SUM(T2.Sentiment_Polarity) DESC LIMIT 1

### 索引 75
- **问题:** How much higher in percentage does the word "grec" occur on the page titled "Àbac" than on the page titled "Astronomia"?
- **数据库:** language_corpus
- **失败原因:** sql_execution_failed
- **模型SQL:** SELECT ((abac_occurrences - astronomia_occurrences) * 100.0 / astronomia_occurrences) AS percentage_difference FROM (SELECT pw1.occurrences AS abac_occurrences, pw2.occurrences AS astronomia_occurrences FROM pages_words pw1 JOIN pages p1 ON pw1.pid = p1.pid JOIN words w ON pw1.wid = w.wid AND w.word = 'grec' AND p1.title = 'Àbac', pages_words pw2 JOIN pages p2 ON pw2.pid = p2.pid JOIN words w2 ON pw2.wid = w2.wid AND w2.word = 'grec' AND p2.title = 'Astronomia')
- **标准SQL:** SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN T3.title = 'Àbac' THEN T2.occurrences END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T3.title = 'Astronomia' THEN T2.occurrences END)) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN T3.title = 'Astronomia' THEN T2.occurrences END) FROM words AS T1 INNER JOIN pages_words AS T2 ON T1.wid = T2.wid INNER JOIN pages AS T3 ON T2.pid = T3.pid WHERE T1.word = 'grec'

### 索引 81
- **问题:** How many times that the word pair of "barcelona" and "precolombina" occur?
- **数据库:** language_corpus
- **失败原因:** sql_execution_failed
- **模型SQL:** SELECT COALESCE(SUM(occurrences), 0) AS total_occurrences FROM biwords WHERE (w1st = (SELECT wid FROM words WHERE word = 'barcelona') AND w2nd = (SELECT wid FROM words WHERE word = 'precolombina')) OR (w1st = (SELECT wid FROM words WHERE word = 'precolombina') AND w2nd = (SELECT wid FROM words WHERE word = 'barcelona'));

- **问题:** Calculate how many percent of sales in North America is higher than the average sale per region for platform ID 9577.
- **数据库:** video_games
- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT ((rs.num_sales - avg_sales.avg_num_sales) / avg_sales.avg_num_sales) * 100 AS percent_difference FROM region_sales rs JOIN region r ON rs.region_id = r.id JOIN game_platform gp ON rs.game_platform_id = gp.id JOIN (SELECT region_id, AVG(num_sales) AS avg_num_sales FROM region_sales WHERE game_platform_id = 9577 GROUP BY region_id) avg_sales ON rs.region_id = avg_sales.region_id WHERE r.region_name = 'North America' AND rs.game_platform_id = 9577;
- **标准SQL:** SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN T2.region_name = 'North America' THEN T1.num_sales ELSE 0 END) - AVG(T1.num_sales)) * 100.0 / AVG(T1.num_sales) FROM region_sales AS T1 INNER JOIN region AS T2 ON T1.region_id = T2.id WHERE T1.game_platform_id = 9577

### 索引 217
- **问题:** Calculate the run rate at the end of 17 overs of the match ID 335987 on 4/18/2008.
- **数据库:** soccer_2016
- **失败原因:** sql_execution_failed
- **模型SQL:** SELECT SUM(bs.Runs_Scored) * 1.0 / 17 AS Run_Rate FROM Batsman_Scored bs JOIN Match m ON bs.Match_Id = m.Match_Id WHERE m.Match_Id = 335987 AND m.Match_Date = '2008-04-18' AND bs.Over_Id <= 17;
- **标准SQL:** SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.Toss_Name = 'bat' THEN T3.Runs_Scored ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Toss_Name = 'field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Toss_Decision AS T1 INNER JOIN Match AS T2 ON T1.Toss_Id = T2.Toss_Decide INNER JOIN Batsman_Scored AS T3 ON T2.Match_Id = T3.Match_Id WHERE T2.Match_Id = 335987 AND T2.Match_Date = '2008-04-18' GROUP BY T3.Over_Id HAVING COUNT(T1.Toss_Name = 'field') = 17

### 索引 318
- **问题:** How many times is the number of active apps in the event that happened at 7:50:28 on 2016/5/2 than in the event that happened at 7:41:03 on 2016/5/2?
- **数据库:** talkingdata
- **失败原因:** sql_execution_failed
- **模型SQL:** SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.timestamp = '2016/5/2 7:50:28' AND ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN e.timestamp = '2016/5/2 7:41:03' AND ae.is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_ratio FROM events e JOIN app_events ae ON e.event_id = ae.event_id;
- **标准SQL:** SELECT SUM(IIF(timestamp = '2016-05-02 7:50:28', 1, 0)) / SUM(IIF(timestamp = '2016-05-02 7:41:03', 1, 0)) AS num FROM events AS T1 INNER JOIN app_events AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.event_id WHERE T2.is_active = '1'

- **数据库:** authors
- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN c.FullName = 'International Conference on Supercomputing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN c.FullName = 'Informatik & Schule' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS Difference FROM Paper p JOIN Conference c ON p.ConferenceId = c.Id WHERE p.Year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2000;
- **标准SQL:** SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.FullName = 'Informatik & Schule' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.FullName = 'International Conference on Supercomputing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DIFF FROM Paper AS T1 INNER JOIN Conference AS T2 ON T1.ConferenceId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Year > 1990 AND T1.Year < 2001

### 索引 915

- **数据库:** car_retails
- **失败原因:** sql_execution_failed
- **模型SQL:** SELECT c.customerName, MAX(order_profit.total_profit) AS max_profit FROM (SELECT od.orderNumber, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * (od.priceEach - p.buyPrice)) AS total_profit FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode GROUP BY od.orderNumber) AS order_profit JOIN orders o ON order_profit.orderNumber = o.orderNumber JOIN customers c ON o.customerNumber = c.customerNumber WHERE order_profit.total_profit = (SELECT MAX(SUM(od.quantityOrdered * (od.priceEach - p.buyPrice))) FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode GROUP BY od.orderNumber);

- **模型SQL:** SELECT (SELECT COUNT(report_no) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(report_no) FROM Crime INNER JOIN Ward ON Crime.ward_no = Ward.ward_no WHERE Ward.alderman_first_name = 'Christopher' AND Ward.alderman_last_name = 'Taliaferro') FROM Crime INNER JOIN Ward ON Crime.ward_no = Ward.ward_no WHERE Crime.domestic = 'TRUE' AND Ward.alderman_first_name = 'Christopher' AND Ward.alderman_last_name = 'Taliaferro') AS domestic_percentage, GROUP_CONCAT(Crime.report_no) AS bank_report_numbers FROM Crime INNER JOIN Ward ON Crime.ward_no = Ward.ward_no WHERE Crime.domestic = 'TRUE' AND Crime.location_description = 'BANK' AND Ward.alderman_first_name = 'Christopher' AND Ward.alderman_last_name = 'Taliaferro';
- **标准SQL:** SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.domestic = 'TRUE' THEN T1.report_no END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.report_no), COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.domestic = 'TRUE' AND T1.location_description = 'BANK' THEN T1.report_no END) AS "number" FROM Crime AS T1 INNER JOIN Ward AS T2 ON T2.ward_no = T1.ward_no WHERE T2.alderman_first_name = 'Christopher' AND T2.alderman_last_name = 'Taliaferro'

### 索引 1874
- **问题:** What is the percentage of increase of the indicator on Adolescent fertility rate from 1960 to 1961 in the country whose Alpha2Code is 1A?
- **数据库:** world_development_indicators
- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT ((SUM(CASE WHEN Year = 1961 THEN Value ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Year = 1960 THEN Value ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Year = 1960 THEN Value ELSE 0 END)) AS PercentageIncrease FROM Indicators INNER JOIN Country ON Indicators.CountryCode = Country.CountryCode WHERE Country.Alpha2Code = '1A' AND Indicators.IndicatorName = 'Adolescent fertility rate (births per 1,000 women ages 15-19)' AND Year IN (1960, 1961);
- **标准SQL:** SELECT (( SELECT T2.Value FROM Country AS T1 INNER JOIN Indicators AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.CountryCode WHERE T1.Alpha2Code = '1A' AND T2.IndicatorName = 'Adolescent fertility rate (births per 1,000 women ages 15-19)' AND T2.Year = 1961 ) - ( SELECT T2.Value FROM Country AS T1 INNER JOIN Indicators AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.CountryCode WHERE T1.Alpha2Code = '1A' AND T2.IndicatorName = 'Adolescent fertility rate (births per 1,000 women ages 15-19)' AND T2.Year = 1960 )) * 1.0 / ( SELECT SUM(T2.Value) FROM Country AS T1 INNER JOIN Indicators AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.CountryCode WHERE T1.Alpha2Code = '1A' AND T2.IndicatorName = 'Adolescent fertility rate (births per 1,000 women ages 15-19)' AND T2.Year = 1960 )

### 索引 2258

- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT d.division, COUNT(DISTINCT m.HomeTeam || m.AwayTeam) AS team_count, (COUNT(DISTINCT m.HomeTeam || m.AwayTeam) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT HomeTeam || AwayTeam) FROM matchs AS m JOIN divisions AS d ON m.Div = d.division WHERE d.country = 'England' AND m.season = 2012)) AS percentage FROM matchs AS m JOIN divisions AS d ON m.Div = d.division WHERE d.country = 'England' AND m.season = 2012 GROUP BY d.division

- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT A.person AS winner_name, A.award AS award_name, E.title AS episode_title, A.role AS winner_role, (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN A.result = 'winner' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*)) AS winning_rate FROM Award A LEFT JOIN Episode E ON A.episode_id = E.episode_id WHERE A.year = 2010 GROUP BY A.person, A.award, E.title, A.role

### 索引 3002
- **问题:** Who is the customer who purchased the largest total cost of products in a single order?
- **数据库:** superstore
- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT p."Customer ID", p."Customer Name", s."Order ID", MAX((s.Sales / (1 - s.Discount)) * s.Quantity - s.Profit) AS LargestTotalCost FROM (SELECT * FROM central_superstore UNION ALL SELECT * FROM east_superstore UNION ALL SELECT * FROM south_superstore UNION ALL SELECT * FROM west_superstore) s JOIN people p ON s."Customer ID" = p."Customer ID" AND s.Region = p.Region GROUP BY p."Customer ID", p."Customer Name", s."Order ID" ORDER BY LargestTotalCost DESC LIMIT 1;
- **标准SQL:** SELECT T2.`Customer Name` FROM east_superstore AS T1 INNER JOIN people AS T2 ON T1.`Customer ID` = T2.`Customer ID` GROUP BY T1.`Order ID`, T2.`Customer Name` ORDER BY SUM((T1.Sales / (1 - T1.Discount)) * T1.Quantity - T1.Profit) DESC LIMIT 1

### 索引 3605
- **问题:** Who was the Law and Order series writer who also won the Television Silver Gavel Award at the American Bar Association Silver Gavel Awards for Media and the Arts for two consecutive years?
- **数据库:** law_episode
- **失败原因:** sql_execution_failed
- **模型SQL:** SELECT p.name FROM Person p JOIN Credit c ON p.person_id = c.person_id JOIN Episode e ON c.episode_id = e.episode_id JOIN Award a ON p.person_id = a.person_id WHERE c.role = 'writer' AND e.series = 'Law and Order' AND a.award = 'Television' AND a.award_category = 'Silver Gavel Award' AND a.organization = 'American Bar Association Silver Gavel Awards for Media and the Arts' AND a.result = 'Winner' GROUP BY p.person_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.year) >= 2 AND MAX(a.year) - MIN(a.year) = 1;

- **模型SQL:** SELECT t.direction, (CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT c.train_id) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trains) * 100) AS percentage FROM cars c JOIN trains t ON c.train_id = t.id GROUP BY t.id HAVING COUNT(c.id) >= 4;

- **问题:** How many times greater is the appearances of the biword pair "a base" than "a decimal"?
- **数据库:** language_corpus
- **失败原因:** sql_execution_failed
- **模型SQL:** SELECT (CAST((b1.occurrences - b2.occurrences) AS FLOAT) / b2.occurrences) AS times_greater FROM biwords AS b1 JOIN words AS w1 ON b1.w1st = w1.wid JOIN words AS w2 ON b1.w2nd = w2.wid JOIN biwords AS b2 ON b2.w1st = w1.wid AND b2.w2nd = (SELECT wid FROM words WHERE word = 'decimal') WHERE w1.word = 'a' AND w2.word = 'base';

- **模型SQL:** SELECT e.EmployeeID, e.FirstName, e.LastName, SUM(od.Quantity * p.Price) AS TotalSales FROM Employees e JOIN Orders o ON e.EmployeeID = o.EmployeeID JOIN OrderDetails od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY e.EmployeeID ORDER BY TotalSales DESC LIMIT 1;
- **标准SQL:** SELECT SUM(T3.UnitPrice * T3.Quantity) FROM Employees AS T1 INNER JOIN Orders AS T2 ON T1.EmployeeID = T2.EmployeeID INNER JOIN `Order Details` AS T3 ON T2.OrderID = T3.OrderID WHERE T1.Title = 'Sales Representative' ORDER BY SUM(T3.UnitPrice * T3.Quantity)

### 索引 4517
- **问题:** What is the difference between average glucose reading for patients in the 20s and 50s?
- **数据库:** synthea
- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN (julianday(o.DATE) - julianday(p.birthdate)) / 365.25 BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN o.VALUE ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN (julianday(o.DATE) - julianday(p.birthdate)) / 365.25 BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN o.PATIENT ELSE NULL END)) - (SUM(CASE WHEN (julianday(o.DATE) - julianday(p.birthdate)) / 365.25 BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN o.VALUE ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN (julianday(o.DATE) - julianday(p.birthdate)) / 365.25 BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN o.PATIENT ELSE NULL END)) AS glucose_difference FROM observations o JOIN patients p ON o.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE o.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%glucose%'
- **标准SQL:** SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND((strftime('%J', T2.DATE) - strftime('%J', T1.birthdate)) / 365) BETWEEN 20 AND 30 THEN T2.VALUE ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN ROUND((strftime('%J', T2.DATE) - strftime('%J', T1.birthdate)) / 365) BETWEEN 20 AND 30 THEN T2.PATIENT END) - SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND((strftime('%J', T2.DATE) - strftime('%J', T1.birthdate)) / 365) BETWEEN 50 AND 60 THEN T2.VALUE ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN ROUND((strftime('%J', T2.DATE) - strftime('%J', T1.birthdate)) / 365) BETWEEN 50 AND 60 THEN T2.PATIENT END) AS difference FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN observations AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Glucose'

- **标准SQL:** SELECT T1.`Order ID` FROM central_superstore AS T1 INNER JOIN product AS T2 ON T1.`Product ID` = T2.`Product ID` WHERE T2.`Product Name` = 'Logitech G600 MMO Gaming Mouse' GROUP BY T1.`Order ID` ORDER BY SUM((T1.Sales / (1 - T1.Discount)) * T1.Quantity - T1.Profit) DESC LIMIT 1

### 索引 4867

### 索引 5145
- **问题:** Find the root beer with the most and least amount of profit per unit and list the container types in which these root beers are sold.
- **数据库:** beer_factory
- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT rb.BrandName, r.ContainerType, (rb.CurrentRetailPrice - rb.WholesaleCost) AS ProfitPerUnit FROM rootbeer r JOIN rootbeerbrand rb ON r.BrandID = rb.BrandID WHERE (rb.CurrentRetailPrice - rb.WholesaleCost) = (SELECT MAX(rb1.CurrentRetailPrice - rb1.WholesaleCost) FROM rootbeerbrand rb1) OR (rb.CurrentRetailPrice - rb.WholesaleCost) = (SELECT MIN(rb2.CurrentRetailPrice - rb2.WholesaleCost) FROM rootbeerbrand rb2)
- **标准SQL:** SELECT * FROM ( SELECT T1.BrandName, T2.ContainerType FROM rootbeerbrand AS T1 INNER JOIN rootbeer AS T2 ON T1.BrandID = T2.BrandID ORDER BY T1.CurrentRetailPrice - T1.WholesaleCost DESC LIMIT 1 ) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ( SELECT T3.BrandName, T4.ContainerType FROM rootbeerbrand AS T3 INNER JOIN rootbeer AS T4 ON T3.BrandID = T4.BrandID ORDER BY T3.CurrentRetailPrice - T3.WholesaleCost ASC LIMIT 1 )

- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT (CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE g1.Chromosome > 10 AND g2.Chromosome > 10) AS REAL) / COUNT(*)) AS possibility FROM Interactions i JOIN Genes g1 ON i.GeneID1 = g1.GeneID JOIN Genes g2 ON i.GeneID2 = g2.GeneID WHERE i.Expression_Corr > 0;

- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ

- **数据库:** olympics
- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT (summer_count - winter_count) AS competitor_difference FROM (SELECT COUNT(gc.person_id) AS summer_count FROM games g JOIN games_competitor gc ON g.id = gc.games_id WHERE g.games_name = '1988 Summer') AS summer, (SELECT COUNT(gc.person_id) AS winter_count FROM games g JOIN games_competitor gc ON g.id = gc.games_id WHERE g.games_name = '1988 Winter') AS winter;

- **标准SQL:** SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Business WHERE business_id IN ( SELECT T1.business_id FROM Business AS T1 INNER JOIN Business_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id WHERE T1.active = 'false' GROUP BY T1.business_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.attribute_id) > 10 )

- **模型SQL:** SELECT (CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Answer WHERE SurveyID = 2019 AND QuestionID = 33 AND AnswerText = 'Yes') AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Answer WHERE SurveyID = 2019 AND QuestionID = 33) - CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Answer WHERE SurveyID = 2016 AND QuestionID = 33 AND AnswerText = 'Yes') AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Answer WHERE SurveyID = 2016 AND QuestionID = 33)) AS rate_of_increase;
- **标准SQL:** SELECT CAST(( SELECT COUNT(T2.UserID) FROM Question AS T1 INNER JOIN Answer AS T2 ON T1.questionid = T2.QuestionID WHERE T2.SurveyID = 2019 AND T1.questiontext LIKE 'Do you currently have a mental health disorder?' AND T2.AnswerText = 'Yes' ) AS REAL) * 100 / ( SELECT COUNT(T2.UserID) FROM Question AS T1 INNER JOIN Answer AS T2 ON T1.questionid = T2.QuestionID WHERE T2.SurveyID = 2016 AND T1.questiontext LIKE 'Do you currently have a mental health disorder?' AND T2.AnswerText = 'Yes' )

- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT (SELECT votes FROM Vote WHERE episode_id = (SELECT episode_id FROM Episode WHERE title = 'The Burns and the Bees') AND stars = 1) - (SELECT votes FROM Vote WHERE episode_id = (SELECT episode_id FROM Episode WHERE title = 'The Burns and the Bees') AND stars = 10) AS vote_difference;

### 索引 6319
- **问题:** Calculate the percentage of congress representatives from the Democrat party. Among them, how many postal points are in the Hawaii state?
- **数据库:** address
- **失败原因:** sql_execution_failed
- **模型SQL:** SELECT (CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.party = 'Democrat' THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(c.congress_rep_id)) * 100 AS democrat_percentage, COUNT(z.zip_code) AS hawaii_postal_points FROM congress c JOIN zip_congress zc ON c.cognress_rep_id = zc.district JOIN zip_data z ON z.zip_code = zc.zip_code WHERE c.party = 'Democrat' AND z.state = 'Hawaii';

- **模型SQL:** SELECT gender, race, AVG(CAST(grad_150_rate AS REAL)) AS avg_grad_150_rate FROM institution_grads INNER JOIN institution_details ON institution_grads.unitid = institution_details.unitid WHERE institution_details.chronname = 'Central Alabama Community College' AND institution_grads.year = 2011 AND (institution_grads.gender = 'F' AND institution_grads.race = 'w' OR institution_grads.gender = 'M' AND institution_grads.race = 'w') GROUP BY institution_grads.gender, institution_grads.race;

- **数据库:** simpson_episodes
- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Award.episode_id) AS episode_count FROM Award JOIN Vote ON Award.episode_id = Vote.episode_id WHERE Award.organization = 'Annie Awards' AND Award.result = 'Nominee' AND Vote.percent > 6;
- **标准SQL:** SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Award AS T1 INNER JOIN Vote AS T2 ON T2.episode_id = T1.episode_id WHERE T1.organization = 'Annie Awards' AND T1.result = 'Nominee' AND T2.percent > 6;

- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ

### 索引 6917
- **问题:** What is the ratio between country with the highest number of infant deaths in 1971 and the lowest number of infant deaths in 1971? List the country with the highest number of infant deaths in 1971 and the lowest number of infant deaths in 1971.
- **数据库:** world_development_indicators
- **失败原因:** sql_execution_failed
- **模型SQL:** SELECT (MAX_IND.Value * 1.0 / MIN_IND.Value) AS Ratio, MAX_IND.CountryName AS CountryWithHighestDeaths, MIN_IND.CountryName AS CountryWithLowestDeaths FROM (SELECT CountryName, Value FROM Indicators WHERE IndicatorName = 'Number of infant deaths' AND Year = 1971 ORDER BY Value DESC LIMIT 1) AS MAX_IND, (SELECT CountryName, Value FROM Indicators WHERE IndicatorName = 'Number of infant deaths' AND Year = 1971 ORDER BY Value ASC LIMIT 1) AS MIN_IND;
- **标准SQL:** SELECT CAST(MAX(value) AS REAL) / MIN(value) FROM indicators WHERE indicatorname = 'Number of infant deaths' AND year = '1971' UNION ALL SELECT countryname FROM ( SELECT countryname, MAX(value) FROM indicators WHERE indicatorname = 'Number of infant deaths' AND year = '1971' ) UNION SELECT countryname FROM ( SELECT countryname, MIN(value) FROM indicators WHERE indicatorname = 'Number of infant deaths' AND year = '1971' )

### 索引 6929
- **问题:** What is the average quantity of product that have been shipped by Federal Shipping in November 1996?
- **数据库:** retail_world
- **失败原因:** sql_execution_failed
- **模型SQL:** SELECT AVG(od.Quantity) AS AverageQuantity FROM Shippers s INNER JOIN Orders o ON s.ShipperID = o.ShipperID INNER JOIN OrderDetails od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE s.ShipperName = 'Federal Shipping' AND o.OrderDate >= '1996-11-01 00:00:00' AND o.OrderDate < '1996-12-01 00:00:00';
- **标准SQL:** SELECT CAST(SUM(T2.Quantity) AS REAL) / COUNT(T2.OrderID) FROM Orders AS T1 INNER JOIN `Order Details` AS T2 ON T1.OrderID = T2.OrderID INNER JOIN Shippers AS T3 ON T1.ShipVia = T3.ShipperID WHERE T1.ShippedDate LIKE '1996-11%' AND T3.CompanyName = 'Federal Shipping'

### 索引 6933

- **数据库:** bike_share_1
- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN subscription_type = 'Subscriber' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN subscription_type = 'Customer' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS difference FROM trip WHERE start_date BETWEEN '6/1/2013 0:00' AND '6/31/2013 12:59';

- **标准SQL:** SELECT DISTINCT T2.`Product Name`, T1.`Ship Mode` FROM west_superstore AS T1 INNER JOIN product AS T2 ON T1.`Product ID` = T2.`Product ID` WHERE T2.Region = 'West' ORDER BY T1.`Ship Date` - T1.`Order Date` LIMIT 1

### 索引 7063
- **问题:** What percentage of games won, games lost and games drawn does Cittadella have as a home team in total?
- **数据库:** european_football_1
- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN FTR = 'H' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_won, (COUNT(CASE WHEN FTR = 'A' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_lost, (COUNT(CASE WHEN FTR = 'D' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_drawn FROM matchs WHERE HomeTeam = 'Cittadella';
- **标准SQL:** SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN FTR = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) / COUNT(HomeTeam) AS REAL) * 100, CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN FTR = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / COUNT(HomeTeam), CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN FTR = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / COUNT(HomeTeam) FROM matchs WHERE HomeTeam = 'Cittadella'

### 索引 7064

- **模型SQL:** SELECT p.title AS project_name, SUM(d.donation_to_project) AS total_collected, ((p.total_price_excluding_optional_support - SUM(d.donation_to_project)) / SUM(d.donation_to_project)) * 100 AS percentage_lacking FROM projects p LEFT JOIN donations d ON p.projectid = d.projectid WHERE p.total_price_excluding_optional_support = (SELECT MAX(total_price_excluding_optional_support) FROM projects) GROUP BY p.projectid;
- **标准SQL:** SELECT T1.title, SUM(T3.donation_to_project), CAST((T2.total_price_excluding_optional_support - SUM(T3.donation_to_project)) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(T3.donation_to_project) FROM essays AS T1 INNER JOIN projects AS T2 ON T1.projectid = T2.projectid INNER JOIN donations AS T3 ON T2.projectid = T3.projectid ORDER BY T2.total_price_excluding_optional_support DESC LIMIT 1

- **模型SQL:** SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || IFNULL(c.MiddleInitial || ' ', '') || c.LastName AS FullName, SUM(s.Quantity * p.Price) AS TotalSpent FROM Sales s JOIN Products p ON s.ProductID = p.ProductID JOIN Customers c ON s.CustomerID = c.CustomerID GROUP BY c.CustomerID HAVING SUM(s.Quantity * p.Price) > 50000 ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC
- **标准SQL:** SELECT DISTINCT T3.FirstName, T3.MiddleInitial, T3.LastName FROM Products AS T1 INNER JOIN Sales AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID INNER JOIN Customers AS T3 ON T2.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID WHERE T2.Quantity * T1.Price > 50000

- **问题:** What is the social number of the client who has the longest delay in his/her complaint? Calculate the days of delay and state the company's response to the consumer.

- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ

- **标准SQL:** SELECT T1.social , 365 * (strftime('%Y', T2.`Date sent to company`) - strftime('%Y', T2.`Date received`)) + 30 * (strftime('%M', T2.`Date sent to company`) - strftime('%M', T2.`Date received`)) + (strftime('%d', T2.`Date sent to company`) - strftime('%d', T2.`Date received`)), T2.`Company response to consumer` FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN events AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.Client_ID ORDER BY 365 * (strftime('%Y', T2.`Date sent to company`) - strftime('%Y', T2.`Date received`)) + 30 * (strftime('%M', T2.`Date sent to company`) - strftime('%M', T2.`Date received`)) + (strftime('%d', T2.`Date sent to company`) - strftime('%d', T2.`Date received`)) DESC LIMIT 1

### 索引 8179
- **问题:** What was the total cost of Xerox 1952 ordered by Aimee Bixby on 2014/9/10?
- **数据库:** superstore
- **失败原因:** sql_execution_failed
- **模型SQL:** SELECT SUBTRACT(MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(Sales, SUBTRACT(1, Discount)), Quantity), Profit) AS total_cost FROM (SELECT * FROM central_superstore UNION ALL SELECT * FROM east_superstore UNION ALL SELECT * FROM south_superstore UNION ALL SELECT * FROM west_superstore) AS all_superstore INNER JOIN people ON all_superstore."Customer ID" = people."Customer ID" AND all_superstore.Region = people.Region INNER JOIN product ON all_superstore."Product ID" = product."Product ID" AND all_superstore.Region = product.Region WHERE people."Customer Name" = 'Aimee Bixby' AND product."Product Name" = 'Xerox 1952' AND all_superstore."Order Date" = date('2014-09-10');

- **标准SQL:** SELECT T.first_name, T.last_name FROM ( SELECT T2.first_name, T2.last_name, COUNT(T1.film_id) AS num FROM film_actor AS T1 INNER JOIN actor AS T2 ON T1.actor_id = T2.actor_id GROUP BY T2.first_name, T2.last_name ) AS T ORDER BY T.num DESC LIMIT 1

- **数据库:** cs_semester

- **模型SQL:** SELECT s.f_name || ' ' || s.l_name AS full_name FROM student s INNER JOIN registration r ON s.student_id = r.student_id INNER JOIN course c ON r.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.name = 'Machine Learning Theory';

### 索引 8250
- **问题:** What is the percentage of people whose age greater than 24 and participate in winter season?
- **数据库:** olympics
- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT (CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT gc.person_id) FROM games_competitor gc JOIN games g ON gc.games_id = g.id WHERE g.season = 'Winter' AND gc.age > 24) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) FROM games_competitor) * 100) AS percentage;
- **标准SQL:** SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.age > 24 AND T1.season = 'Winter' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.games_id) FROM games AS T1 INNER JOIN games_competitor AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.games_id

### 索引 8254
- **问题:** What is the chapter description where the paragraph "What, wilt thou hear some music, my sweet love?" belongs?
- **数据库:** shakespeare
- **失败原因:** sql_execution_failed
- **模型SQL:** SELECT chapters.Description FROM paragraphs JOIN chapters ON paragraphs.chapter_id = chapters.id WHERE paragraphs.PlainText = 'What, wilt thou hear some music, my sweet love?'

### 索引 8255
- **问题:** Find the store ID with more orders between "Aurora" and "Babylon" city.
- **数据库:** regional_sales
- **失败原因:** sql_results_differ
- **模型SQL:** SELECT s.StoreID FROM "Store Locations" s JOIN "Sales Orders" o ON s.StoreID = o._StoreID WHERE s."City Name" IN ('Aurora (Town)', 'Babylon (Town)') GROUP BY s.StoreID ORDER BY COUNT(o.OrderNumber) DESC LIMIT 1;
- **标准SQL:** SELECT T2.StoreID FROM `Sales Orders` AS T1 INNER JOIN `Store Locations` AS T2 ON T2.StoreID = T1._StoreID WHERE T2.`City Name` = 'Aurora (Township)' OR T2.`City Name` = 'Babylon (Town)' GROUP BY T2.StoreID ORDER BY COUNT(T1.OrderNumber) DESC LIMIT 1
